import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class F_v1 {
    private static final int MOD = 998244353;
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        new F_v1().run();
    }

    void run() throws Exception {
        InputReader in = new InputReader(System.in);
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int K = in.nextInt();
        int L = in.nextInt();
        
        int[][] fif = precomputeFactorials(10000, MOD);
        long[] muls = new long[n + 1];
        
        for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
            long comb = nCk(n, i, MOD, fif);
            for (int j = i; j <= n; j++) {
                long term = comb * nCk(n - i, n - j, MOD, fif) % MOD;
                if ((j - i) % 2 == 1) term = (MOD - term) % MOD;
                muls[j] = (muls[j] + term) % MOD;
            }
        }
        
        long ans = 0;
        for (int i = K; i <= n; i++) {
            long term = pow(2, i, MOD)
                    * fif[0][i] % MOD
                    * fif[1][i] % MOD
                    * fif[1][(2 * i + 1) % MOD] % MOD
                    * muls[i] % MOD;
            ans = (ans + term) % MOD;
        }
        
        ans = (ans * L) % MOD;
        if (ans < 0) ans += MOD;
        out.println(ans);
        out.flush();
    }

    public static long nCk(int n, int r, int mod, int[][] fif) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0;
        return (long) fif[0][n] * fif[1][r] % mod * fif[1][n - r] % mod;
    }

    public static long pow(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = result * base % mod;
            base = base * base % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    public static int[][] precomputeFactorials(int max, int mod) {
        int[] fact = new int[max + 1];
        int[] invFact = new int[max + 1];
        fact[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= max; i++) {
            fact[i] = (int) ((long) fact[i - 1] * i % mod);
        }
        invFact[max] = modPow(fact[max], mod - 2, mod);
        for (int i = max - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            invFact[i] = (int) ((long) invFact[i + 1] * (i + 1) % mod);
        }
        return new int[][]{fact, invFact};
    }

    private static int modPow(int base, int exp, int mod) {
        int result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) result = (int) ((long) result * base % mod);
            base = (int) ((long) base * base % mod);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static class InputReader {
        private InputStream stream;
        private byte[] buf = new byte[1024];
        private int curChar, numChars;

        public InputReader(InputStream stream) {
            this.stream = stream;
        }

        private int read() {
            if (numChars == -1) throw new RuntimeException();
            if (curChar >= numChars) {
                curChar = 0;
                try { numChars = stream.read(buf); } catch (IOException e) { throw new RuntimeException(e); }
                if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
            }
            return buf[curChar++];
        }

        public int nextInt() {
            int c = read();
            while (isSpaceChar(c)) c = read();
            int sign = 1;
            if (c == '-') {
                sign = -1;
                c = read();
            }
            int res = 0;
            do {
                if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw new RuntimeException();
                res = res * 10 + c - '0';
                c = read();
            } while (!isSpaceChar(c));
            return res * sign;
        }

        private boolean isSpaceChar(int c) { return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1; }
    }
}
